name: Xoi ca ro
summary: Xôi cá rô is sticky rice with fried đồng snakehead, fried shallot, rau răm, and mùi tàu. Thế giới tiếp thị says to eat it hot, and that the fish fat turns the rice a deep yellow. A street and a price are Check on arrival.
origin: Nam Định, on Thế giới tiếp thị, 12 September 2022. A street was not printed.
texture: The rice stays chewy and does not fall apart. The fish is sweet and firm, and the fat makes the grains glossy.
howToEat: Hot. Thế giới tiếp thị names cold weather and does not print a clock. Check on arrival. A price is Check on arrival.
where: Nam Định. A street was not printed. Check on arrival.
